description: Overview dashboard for WAF Water Treatment Plant.

items.info: Count registration records.
items.label: Total WTPs

items.info: COUNT DISTINCT IDs WHERE Date of inspection? < 12 months.
items.label: Inspected (12 mo)

items.info:
Plant is OPERATIONAL when :
  • Have you noted any production constraints? = No (no production constraints), AND
  • What is the average daily production of the plant in megalitres? > 0, AND
  • Are there any risks associated with the Pumps/Rising Main? = No (where Pumps/Rising Main is part of transport), AND
  • Are there any risks associated with the Borehole Pump? = No (where Borehole Pump is part of transport), AND
  • Are there any risks associated with the Borehole Gallery Pumps? = No (where Borehole Gallery Pumps part of transport).
% = operational / total plants.
items.label: % Operational

items.info:
Plant compliant when :
  • E.coli (What is the number of E.Coli (using Lab test)? OR What is the number of E.Coli (using CBT bag test)?) = 0 /100mL, AND
  • Total coliform (What is the Total Coliform in cfu/100ml?) = 0, AND
  • Faecal coliform (What is the Feacal Coliform in cfu/100ml?) = 0, AND
  • Turbidity (What is the Turbidity in NTU?) < 5 NTU, AND
  • Residual Cl (What is the Residual Chlorine in mg/L?) ∈ [0.2, 0.5] mg/L, AND
  • pH (pH - 4500-H+B (APHA Method Code)) ∈ [6.5, 8.5], AND
  • Conductivity (Conductivity µS/cm - 2510B (APHA Method Code)) < 1000 µS/cm, AND
  • Salinity (Salinity PPT 2520B 0.2 (APHA Method Code)) < 1 ppt
% = compliant / total plants.
items.label: DW Compliance

items.info: Plant RED when: DW Compliance = Non-compliant OR Plant is Non-Operational
items.label: Critical

items.info:
Stacked-bar per parameter (Pass / Fail), each plant counted once:
  E. coli: COUNT(value = 0 using either lab What is the number of E.Coli (using Lab test)? or CBT What is the number of E.Coli (using CBT bag test)?)
  Total coliform: COUNT(What is the Total Coliform in cfu/100ml? = 0)
  Faecal coliform: COUNT(What is the Feacal Coliform in cfu/100ml? = 0)
  Turbidity: COUNT(What is the Turbidity in NTU? < 5)
  Residual Cl: COUNT(What is the Residual Chlorine in mg/L? ∈ [0.2, 0.5])
  pH: COUNT(pH - 4500-H+B (APHA Method Code) ∈ [6.5, 8.5])
  Conductivity: COUNT(Conductivity µS/cm - 2510B (APHA Method Code) < 1000)
  Salinity: COUNT(Salinity PPT 2520B 0.2 (APHA Method Code) < 1)
Donut: COUNT plants per option of Method of Water Testing used? (multi-select — a plant choosing both counts in both segments OR show three categories Lab / CBT / Both).

Per plant: utilisation = What is the average daily production of the plant in megalitres? / What is the Designed Capacity of Plant in megalitres?. Plot bar per plant (design vs production) for each division.

Horizontal bar: # plants per process. Derive 'process in use' from:
  • Coagulation/Flocculation — Are there any Floc Tanks used in the Plant? = Yes
  • Sedimentation/Clarification — Are there any Clarifier /Sedimentation Tanks at the Plant? = Yes
  • Filtration — Are there any Filtration System at the Plant? = Yes
  • Backwash sludge removal — Are there any Backwash Sludge Removal System at the Plant? = Yes
  • Disinfection — What Disinfection Techniques are used at the Plant? non-empty
  • Chemical-specific (Alum, Polymer, Lime, Soda Ash) — What chemicals are use for water treatment on the day of Inspection ? options

Sankey stages:
  All plants → Do you have a OHS policy for the Plant? = Yes → Do your staff use OHS equipment at the work place? = Yes → Do plant staff comply to the requirements of the OHS Policy? = Yes.
Each transition's width = count of plants meeting all prior conditions.

items.info:
Horizontal bar per chemical (Chlorine / Potassium Aluminium Sulphate / Polymer / Lime / Sodium Carbonate). Stacked:
  Green = in use (What chemicals are use for water treatment on the day of Inspection ? contains chemical) AND risks=No.
  Red   = in use AND risks=Yes.
Plants not using the chemical excluded from the bar.
items.description: Green = chemical in use with no risks logged · Red = in use with a risk/issue logged. Plants not using a chemical are excluded from its bar.

items.info: Histogram of plants by How many Floc Tanks are there at the Plant? (only counting plants where Are there any Floc Tanks used in the Plant? = Yes).

Bar of # tanks per type from Types of Clarifiers/Sedimentation Tanks at the Plant (multi-select: Horizontal Flow / Up Flow Vertical / Rectangle Lamella Plates / Lamella Tubes).
Sum How many Clarifiers/Sedimentation Tanks are there? across plants reporting each type.

Horizontal bar across risk options:
  COUNT plants where each option appears in What are these risks? OR What are these risks associated with the Clarifiers/Sedimentation Tanks?.
  Options: Overloading / High turbidity / Low retention time / Carried over flocs / Mechanical / Electrical / Desludging / Other.

Donut of plants per option of What Disinfection Techniques are used at the Plant? (Chlorine gas / HTH Powder / Sodium Hypochlorite / DPD Tablets). Plus side note: % with disinfection SOP (Do you have Standard Operating Procedures for Disinfection? = Yes).

Horizontal bar across risk categories aggregated from all four techniques:
  Storage / Dosage / Handling / Leakage / Other.
  Each option counted across What are these risks associated with Chlorine Gas dosing?, What are these risks associated with HTH Powder Dosing System?, What are these risks associated with the Sodium Hypochlorite Dosing System?, What are these risks associated with the DPD Tablets Dosing Method?.
items.description: Risks logged against chlorine-gas dosing. Risks for other disinfection techniques (HTH, hypochlorite, DPD) are not yet unioned in.

items.info:
Bar with categories: No meter (count of Are there Plant Mag Flow Meters in place?=No) / Inflow / Outflow / Both.
  Inflow / Outflow / Both derived from What are type of Flow Meters? (multi-select).
items.description: No meter = plant reports no magnetic flow meter in place. Inflow / Outflow / Both derived from the meter placement(s) recorded.

items.info: Horizontal bar across risk options of What are these risks associated with the flow meters?: Flooded flow meter / No Flow Meter / Uncalibrated Meter / Incorrect reading / Buried meters / Defunct Meters / Other.
Histogram of plants by Number of High Lift Pumps? (0 = plants with Are there any High Lift Pumps at the Plant?=No).

Stacked bar with three segments:
  Green = Do you have a backup generator at this Facility=Yes AND Is the backup generator well maintained and functional?=Yes
  Amber = Do you have a backup generator at this Facility=Yes AND Is the backup generator well maintained and functional?=No
  Red   = Do you have a backup generator at this Facility=No (no back-up at all)
items.description: Green = generator present & well maintained · Amber = present but poorly maintained · Red = no back-up generator.

items.info:
Per subsystem, plants whose latest monitoring registered no risk against it versus plants that did.
  • Raw water pumps — Are there risks associated with the rising main pumps?
  • High-lift pumps — Are there risks associated with the high lift pumps?
  • Pre-chlorination / Alum / Soda ash / Polymer / Lime — the dosing risk question for each chemical
Denominators differ per subsystem: a plant is only asked about a chemical it actually doses, so each bar counts only the plants using that subsystem. Borehole and borehole-gallery pumps are omitted — no plant has answered their risk questions yet.
items.description: Green = subsystem in use with no risk registered · Red = risk registered. Both pumps and dosing are High-priority DWS indicators.

items.info:
Count of plants per option of What is the raw water source? (multi-select — a plant drawing from both sources counts in both bars). Comprehensive monitoring form only.
The design also splits each source by whether a risk is registered against it, but issues_risk_associated_with_surface_water_source and ...ground_water_source have no submissions yet, so that split is not shown — rendering it would assert "no risks" where the truth is "not yet asked".
items.description: Surface versus ground water across the fleet. The risk overlay is pending data on the source-risk questions.

items.info:
Group monitoring submissions by month over the last 12 months. Per month, each line is the % of plants passing that domain:
  • Drinking water — Turbidity < 5 NTU AND Total coliform = 0 cfu/100ml
  • Disinfection — Do you have SOPs for disinfection? = Yes
  • Operational — Do you have SOPs? = Yes
  • OHS — Do you have an OHS policy? = Yes
E. coli is not in the drinking-water rule: e_coli_cfu_100ml has no submissions, so including it would drop every plant out of the denominator.
items.title: Compliance Trend
items.subtitle: last 12 months · % plants passing each domain
items.description: Each line is the share of plants that passed that check in the month they were monitored, so a line can move because conditions changed or because a different set of plants was visited.

items.info:
Every registered site with at least one monitoring submission.
The escalation endpoint requires criteria, and its grammar has no match-all, so the criteria below OR together questions that every monitored site answers — the count stops growing as further questions are added, which is how coverage was checked. Sites never monitored do not appear.
items.label: All Water Treatment Plants
items.description: Every monitored site in this family. Click a row to open its site profile.
